stories.headline: Nvidia Launches Nemotron 3 Nano Omni, Open Multimodal Model Unifying Vision, Audio, and Text

key_facts.fact: Nemotron 3 Nano Omni uses a 30B-A3B hybrid mixture-of-experts architecture with a 256K context length, combining vision and audio encoders into a single model.
key_facts.excerpt: By combining vision and audio encoders within its 30B-A3B, hybrid mixture-of-experts architecture, Nemotron 3 Nano Omni eliminates the need for separate perception models.

key_facts.fact: The model tops six leaderboards for complex document intelligence and video/audio understanding, including MMlongbench-Doc, OCRBenchV2, WorldSense, DailyOmni, and VoiceBench.
key_facts.excerpt: Nemotron 3 Nano Omni delivers best-in-class accuracy on complex document intelligence leaderboards such as MMlongbench-Doc, OCRBenchV2, while also leading in video and audio leaderboards like WorldSense and DailyOmni.

key_facts.fact: The model delivers up to 9x higher throughput than other open omni models with the same interactivity, enabling lower-cost multimodal agent deployments.
key_facts.excerpt: AI systems to achieve 9x higher throughput than other open omni models with the same interactivity.

key_facts.fact: Companies already adopting or evaluating the model include Foxconn, H Company, Palantir, Dell Technologies, Docusign, Infosys, and Oracle.
key_facts.excerpt: AI and software companies already adopting Nemotron 3 Nano Omni include Aible, Applied Scientific Intelligence (ASI), Eka Care, Foxconn, H Company, Palantir and Pyler, with Dell Technologies, Docusign, Infosys, K-Dense, Lila, Oracle and Zefr evaluating the model.

key_facts.fact: The Nemotron model family has seen over 50 million downloads in the past year.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia said the Nemotron family – including Ultra, Super and Nano – has seen over 50 million downloads in the past year.

key_facts.fact: On the OSWorld computer-use benchmark, Nemotron 3 Nano Omni scores 47.4 vs. 29.0 for Qwen3-Omni 30B-A3B, and on ScreenSpot-Pro GUI benchmark scores 57.8 vs. 59.7.
key_facts.excerpt: OSWorld: 47.4 (Nemotron 3 Nano Omni) vs 29.0 (Qwen3-Omni 30B-A3B); ScreenSpot-Pro: 57.8 vs 59.7

stories.headline: Poolside Launches Laguna XS.2 Open-Weight and M.1 Proprietary Models for Agentic Coding

key_facts.fact: Laguna XS.2 is a 33B-parameter MoE model with 3B active parameters, released under Apache 2.0 license, designed for local agentic coding.
key_facts.excerpt: Laguna XS.2: an Apache 2.0 open licensed 33-billion parameter MoE with 3 billion active. Engineered for efficiency and community innovation, this model is designed for local agentic coding tasks.

key_facts.fact: Laguna M.1 is a proprietary 225B-parameter MoE model with 23B active parameters, optimized for complex, long-horizon software engineering problems.
key_facts.excerpt: Laguna M.1: a proprietary 225-billion parameter Mixture of Experts (MoE) model with 23 billion active parameters. This flagship model is optimized for high-consequence enterprise and government environments.

key_facts.fact: Both models were trained from scratch in-house using Poolside's Muon optimizer, not fine-tuned from existing open-source models like Qwen.
key_facts.excerpt: The new Lagunas were trained from scratch, not fine-tuned base models from Chinese giant Alibaba's Qwen series. Poolside's internal training process uses a unique tool called Muon optimizer.

key_facts.fact: Poolside also launched 'pool', a coding agent harness, and 'shimmer', a web-based interactive preview environment for agentic coding on the go.
key_facts.excerpt: a new coding agent harness called (fittingly) 'pool' and a new web-based, mobile optimized agentic coding development and interactive preview environment, 'shimmer'.

key_facts.fact: The Laguna architecture features per-layer head counts and a sigmoid MoE router with auxiliary-loss-free load balancing.
key_facts.excerpt: Laguna is Poolside's mixture-of-experts language model family that extends standard SwiGLU MoE transformers with two key innovations. It features per-layer head counts... and implements a sigmoid MoE router with auxiliary-loss-free load balancing.

key_facts.fact: M.1 is being offered free temporarily through Poolside's API and distribution partners OpenRouter, Ollama, and Baseten.
key_facts.excerpt: Poolside is offering even the larger M.1 for free temporarily through its API and third-party distribution partners, OpenRouter, Ollama, and Baseten.

stories.headline: Anthropic Launches 9 Creative Connectors Integrating Claude With Blender, Adobe, Autodesk, and More

key_facts.fact: Anthropic released nine MCP-based connectors partnering with Blender, Adobe, Autodesk Fusion, Ableton, Splice, Affinity by Canva, SketchUp, and Resolume (Arena and Wire).
key_facts.excerpt: Today, with a coalition of partners including Blender, Autodesk, Adobe, Ableton, and Splice, we're releasing a set of connectors—tools that let Claude work alongside the software creative professionals rely on.

key_facts.fact: The Adobe for creativity connector gives Claude access to 50+ tools across Creative Cloud apps including Photoshop, Premiere, Express, Illustrator, Firefly, and Lightroom.
key_facts.excerpt: What sets the Adobe for creativity connector apart is access to 50+ pro-grade tools from our creative suite, working together intelligently to help you get to the best creative outcome.

key_facts.fact: The Autodesk Fusion connector lets designers and engineers create and modify 3D models through natural-language conversations with Claude.
key_facts.excerpt: Autodesk Fusion MCP connects Claude directly to the Fusion environment for Fusion subscribers, so ideas can move beyond the prompt and into real, structured design work.

key_facts.fact: The Blender connector provides a natural-language interface to Blender's Python API, and Anthropic joined the Blender Development Fund as a patron.
key_facts.excerpt: Blender offers a natural-language interface to its Python API, allowing users to explore and understand complex setups and making it easier to access Blender's documentation.

key_facts.fact: All connectors are built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), making them vendor-maintained and accessible to other large language models beyond Claude.
key_facts.excerpt: The connectors are MCP under the hood. The wire format is the same Model Context Protocol that powers every other Claude integration.

stories.headline: Mayo Clinic AI System Detects Pancreatic Cancer on CT Scans 475 Days Before Clinical Diagnosis

key_facts.fact: REDMOD (Radiomics-based Early Detection MODel) identified subtle pancreatic cancer changes on routine CT scans an average of 475 days before clinical diagnosis.
key_facts.excerpt: The model, developed by researchers at Mayo Clinic and collaborators, identified subtle changes in routine computerised tomography scans, or CT scans, an average of about 475 days before patients were diagnosed.

key_facts.fact: REDMOD correctly identified 73% of pre-diagnostic cases versus only 39% for radiologists reviewing the same images.
key_facts.excerpt: REDMOD and found it was able to identify 73% of very early pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. In contrast, only 39% of these cases were identified by radiologists.

key_facts.fact: For scans taken more than two years before diagnosis, the AI detected 68% of cases versus 23% for radiologists — nearly three times the detection rate.
key_facts.excerpt: The advantage widened for scans taken more than two years before diagnosis, where the system detected 68 per cent of cases versus 23 per cent for radiologists.

key_facts.fact: The model was trained and tested on scans from more than 1,400 people, including 219 patients whose earlier scans had been read as normal but who later developed pancreatic cancer.
key_facts.excerpt: It was trained and tested on scans from more than 1,400 people, including 219 patients whose earlier scans had been read as normal but who later developed pancreatic cancer.

key_facts.fact: The study was published April 28 in the journal Gut; pancreatic cancer has a five-year survival rate of about 10% globally, with over 85% of cases found at advanced stage.
key_facts.excerpt: More than 85 per cent of cases are found at a stage where treatment is largely limited to easing symptoms, helping explain why the five-year survival rate is about 10 per cent globally.

key_facts.fact: The model correctly classified more than 80% of scans from people who did not develop cancer, and showed 90–92% longitudinal consistency on repeat scans.
key_facts.excerpt: The ability of the model to identify people without the disease was also good and it correctly identified 88% of people who did not have pancreatic cancer. When patients had repeat scans, the AI's risk score was very consistent, agreeing 90–92% of the time.

key_facts.fact: Modeling studies cited in the paper suggest increasing localized pancreatic cancer detection from 10% to 50% would more than double survival rates.
key_facts.excerpt: Modelling studies indicate that increasing the proportion of localised pancreatic ductal carcinomas from 10 per cent to 50 per cent would more than double survival rates.

stories.headline: AWS Launches Amazon Quick Desktop App, a Proactive AI Assistant That Learns From Your Work

key_facts.fact: Amazon Quick is a desktop AI assistant that connects to local files, calendar, email, and apps like Google Workspace, Zoom, Microsoft 365, Salesforce, and Slack.
key_facts.excerpt: It works directly with your local files, stays connected to your calendar, email, and other apps in the background, and learns the context of your work.

key_facts.fact: Quick builds a personal knowledge graph from each user's interactions, becoming more personalized and proactive over time.
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon Quick is powered by a personal knowledge graph that's based on each user's desktop interactions. It connects their local files, their calendar, email inbox and important applications, and then it sits there and learns.

key_facts.fact: New integrations include Google Workspace, Zoom, Airtable, Dropbox, and Microsoft Teams, with free and Plus pricing plans requiring no AWS account.
key_facts.excerpt: Quick is expanding its native integrations to include Google Workspace, Zoom, Airtable, Dropbox, and Microsoft Teams... New Free and Plus pricing plans for Quick.

key_facts.fact: Quick can proactively surface information — reminding users of unanswered emails, outstanding Salesforce deals, or documents requiring attention.
key_facts.excerpt: Quick will monitor their work in order to take proactive action, surfacing information before it's requested. For instance, it can remind someone that they still need to reply to a priority email.

key_facts.fact: Announced at the 'What's Next with AWS' event, which also revealed OpenAI models GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.4 coming to Amazon Bedrock in limited preview.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI models GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.4 coming to Amazon Bedrock in limited preview... Codex coding agent available on Amazon Bedrock.

stories.headline: FIDO Alliance Forms AI Agent Working Groups; Google Donates Agent Payments Protocol to 60 Partners

key_facts.fact: The FIDO Alliance formed an Agentic Authentication Technical Working Group and a Payments Technical Working Group to develop standards for AI agent transactions.
key_facts.excerpt: The FIDO Alliance today announced initiatives to develop interoperable standards for agentic interactions and commerce. These initiatives include the formation of an Agentic Authentication Technical Working Group.

key_facts.fact: Google donated the Agent Payments Protocol (AP2) to FIDO and released AP2 v0.2 on GitHub, introducing 'Human Not Present' payments for autonomous agent transactions.
key_facts.excerpt: We're donating the Agent Payments Protocol (AP2) to the FIDO Alliance... Today on GitHub, we're also releasing AP2 v.0.2, which introduces critical updates for autonomous transactions, including 'Human Not Present' payments.

key_facts.fact: Mastercard co-developed Verifiable Intent, a tamper-proof log of user-authorized agent actions, also donated to FIDO alongside AP2.
key_facts.excerpt: Verifiable Intent, a new, AP2-compatible standard co-developed with Mastercard and also being donated to FIDO, that creates a tamper-proof log of user-authorized agent actions to ensure accountability.

key_facts.fact: 60 organizations joined the initiative including Adyen, American Express, Ant International, Coinbase, Etsy, PayPal, Revolut, Salesforce, Visa, and Worldpay.
key_facts.excerpt: Adyen. American Express. Ant International. Coinbase. Etsy. Forter. Intuit. JCB. Mastercard. Mysten Labs. PayPal. Revolut. Salesforce. ServiceNow. UnionPay International. Worldpay. Sixty organizations in total.

key_facts.fact: The Agentic Authentication Working Group is chaired by CVS Health, Google, and OpenAI, and vice-chaired by Amazon, Google, and Okta.
key_facts.excerpt: At launch, the group is chaired by members from CVS Health, Google, and OpenAI, and vice-chaired by members from Amazon, Google, and Okta.

key_facts.fact: Some analysts estimate agentic commerce could reach $5 trillion globally by 2030, underscoring the urgency for payment and authentication standards.
key_facts.excerpt: agent-driven use cases, including agentic commerce, which some analysts estimate could reach $5 trillion globally by 2030.

stories.headline: China Suspends New Autonomous Vehicle Licenses After 100+ Baidu Robotaxis Stalled in Wuhan

key_facts.fact: China has suspended issuing new Level 4 autonomous vehicle licenses, preventing companies from adding robotaxis, starting new pilots, or expanding to new cities.
key_facts.excerpt: The halt means self-driving companies cannot add robotaxis to their existing fleets, launch new pilot projects, or expand into additional cities.

key_facts.fact: The suspension was triggered by a March 31 incident where more than 100 Apollo Go robotaxis suddenly stalled on roads in Wuhan, stranding passengers and disrupting traffic.
key_facts.excerpt: After dozens of Baidu's Apollo Go robotaxis suddenly stopped in Wuhan in March, stranding passengers and disrupting traffic... more than 100 Apollo Go robotaxis stalled on city streets on March 31.

key_facts.fact: Three agencies including the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology convened a meeting in April with officials from cities operating robotaxi pilots.
key_facts.excerpt: Three agencies including the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology convened a meeting earlier in April with officials from cities that have robotaxis or autonomous-driving pilots.

key_facts.fact: Baidu's Wuhan robotaxi operations have also been suspended while local authorities investigate the outage.
key_facts.excerpt: Baidu's robotaxi operations in Wuhan have also been suspended as local authorities' investigation into the outage is underway.

key_facts.fact: Baidu shares fell about 4% in Hong Kong, while rivals Pony.ai dropped 7% and WeRide declined 3%; both rivals confirmed their services continue operating normally.
key_facts.excerpt: Baidu's Hong Kong-traded shares fell about 2% as of press time. Shares of its main rivals, Pony AI and WeRide, dropped 6% and 3%, respectively.

key_facts.fact: This is at least the second time Chinese regulators have paused new permits due to a Baidu-related incident; duration of suspension remains unclear.
key_facts.excerpt: This marks at least the second time that regulators have paused new permits due to a Baidu-related incident.

key_facts.fact: China's autonomous driving industry is estimated to be worth 83.1 billion yuan ($15.5B) by 2030, per Soochow Securities analysis.
key_facts.excerpt: The halt comes as a setback to a fast-growing industry that is estimated to be worth 83.1 billion yuan (S$15.52 billion) by 2030, according to analysis by Soochow Securities.
